# United Americas
The [bold]United Americas[/bold] (UA) is a superpower formed in 2104 by the nations of North, Central and South America, in answer to the rise of the [textlink="Three World Empire" link="CMUGuideLoreTWE"]. It fields one of the most formidable militaries in human space and the strongest industrial base on the frontier.
## Government - In practice an extension of the United States government, run by a President, Vice President and a Congress representing every member nation. - Most UA colonies lie in the [bold]American Arm[/bold] of the Outer Rim, with more strung along the frontier.
## Relations - [bold]Three World Empire[/bold]: allies bound by treaties, but the UA keeps a close eye on the TWE's expansion. - [bold]Union of Progressive Peoples[/bold]: a long cold war that has turned into more and more border clashes over disputed worlds. - [bold]Weyland-Yutani[/bold]: deep business ties, but growing distrust after the Corporate mishandling of many UA worlds.
## Civil Organizations - [bold]Colonial Administration[/bold], an civilian organization formed to protect the rights of American off-world colonists and manage the UA's Colonies. - [bold]Colonial Marshals[/bold]: the civilian law enforcement arm of Colonial Administration, with offices across the colonies. Its [bold]Crisis Intervention Unit[/bold] handles hostage situations, strikes, terrorism and any crisis beyond local police.
## Military Forces The [bold]United Americas Allied Command[/bold] directs the militaries of every member nation. - [bold]United States Colonial Marines[/bold] (USCM): founded in 2101, before the UA itself, and the spearhead of every UA campaign. Split into the Sol, Eridani and Herculis branches, with reserves on Earth. - [bold]USCM Hazardous Operations Unit[/bold] (HAZOPS): specialists in chemical, biological, radiological and explosive threats. - [bold]Latin American Colonial Navy[/bold] (LACN): its Landing Forces specialize in rapid deployment and shock tactics for planetary assault and occupation. - Other UA military forces include: the [bold]Canadian Colonial Armed Forces[/bold], the [bold]US Aerospace Force[/bold], the [bold]UA Colonial Guard[/bold], the [bold]US Colonial Coast Guard[/bold], the [bold]Outer Rim Defense Fleet[/bold] and the [bold]US Army[/bold].
